subject_session: 5 linear-track sessions (Achilles-10252013, Buddy-06272013, Cicero-09012014, Cicero-09172014, Gatsby-08022013); 4 rats
stated_limitation: the mean phase advance measured model-free (figure 6, panel D, about −60° from field entry to exit) is much shallower than the fitted ridge slope of −194°, because a substantial fraction of in-field spikes sit off the precession ridge and pull the circular mean toward the overall preferred phase.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1) is the canonical theta-precession dataset, and the circular-maze sessions are correctly excluded in favor of the five bidirectional linear tracks.
justification.handling: Files are streamed with remfile, the maze epoch is correctly isolated, position is differentiated with gap-blanking, velocity is thresholded and split by direction, and units are filtered to excitatory cells.
justification.analysis: The Kempter et al. circular-linear regression is the correct method, the direction-dependent within-field sign convention is handled explicitly, and significance comes from a phase-position shuffle that preserves theta locking while destroying only the pairing.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (204 fields, 52 significant, median −194°, 75% negative, binomial p=4.1e-4) reproduces verbatim from the transcript's printed output and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: The diagonal band is clearly visible in the pooled and significant-only density panels, examples are ranked by correlation strength (rho) rather than fitted slope, and axes carry units and sample sizes throughout.
justification.honesty: The write-up is proportionate and names specific limitations: the model-free vs fitted-slope discrepancy, spike-count-limited detection, per-session variability, excluded circular sessions, and the non-layer-referenced phase.
justification.verdict: Sound dataset, correct circular statistics with a proper null, reproducing numbers, and clear figures make this an accept with no required revisions.
